cargo.ranking_methodology: Operator focus records the chosen development direction separately from evidence rank. Evidence rank reflects relevance and directness within the current local evidence only; it is not a validated efficacy score and does not override operator choice.

candidates.name: Native MSC-EV secretome cargo
candidates.source: MSC-derived small extracellular vesicles; final source-cell strategy not selected
candidates.mechanism: Multi-component paracrine signaling intended to support neuroregeneration-relevant and inflammation-modulating activity; active components remain undefined.
candidates.rationale: This is the operator-selected program focus because it preserves the multi-component EV thesis and has relevant rodent activity, while MISEV2023 highlights the characterization burden.
candidates.uncertainty: The active cargo components, potency mechanism, source-cell dependence, and relevance to cognition or aging are not established.

candidates.name: Curcumin-loaded EV benchmark
candidates.source: Exogenous curcumin loaded into an exosome preparation
candidates.mechanism: Delivery of an anti-inflammatory small-molecule payload using EVs as a carrier.
candidates.rationale: The current evidence is more cargo-specific than for the native secretome, making this an informative benchmark rather than the selected product focus.
candidates.uncertainty: The cited mouse models and loaded payload do not establish relevance to an unengineered SGL-001 product or human cognitive benefit.

candidates.name: STAT3-inhibitor-loaded EV benchmark
candidates.source: Exogenous STAT3 inhibitor loaded into an exosome preparation
candidates.mechanism: EV-mediated delivery of a pathway-directed inhibitor in a model-specific CNS context.
candidates.rationale: This is retained as a pathway-directed delivery benchmark, not as the current SGL-001 development focus.
candidates.uncertainty: Model-specific activity, payload safety, and relevance to cognition or aging remain unresolved.

pathways.name: Neuroinflammation modulation
pathways.description: Inflammation-modulating activity reported across local preclinical EV evidence; direction and causal cargo are product- and model-dependent.

pathways.name: Neurogenesis and neural plasticity
pathways.description: Preservation or modulation of neurogenesis and functional outcomes observed in rodent injury models, not established in aging or humans.

evidence_links.rationale: Supports model-specific activity of native MSC-derived EV preparations.
Supports native MSC-EV activity and source-cell scalability as a testable concept.
Directly reports the loaded small-molecule EV benchmark in mice.
Directly reports a pathway-directed loaded EV benchmark in mice.

pathway_links.rationale: The cited model reported reduced inflammation after native MSC-EV treatment.
The cited rodent studies support investigation of neurogenesis or tissue-preservation effects.
The loaded curcumin benchmark was evaluated for inflammation-related activity.
The pathway-directed inhibitor provides a mechanistic benchmark in a CNS model.

next_actions.action: Define the analytical comparison needed to distinguish native secretome activity from loaded-cargo benchmarks.
next_actions.objective: Make cargo strategy selection evidence-driven without displacing the operator-selected native EV focus.
next_actions.rationale: The current evidence is heterogeneous and does not identify the active native cargo components.
next_actions.uncertainty: Whether native MSC-EV cargo provides reproducible neuroregeneration-relevant activity beyond cargo-loaded benchmarks.
success_criteria: A human-approved comparison plan links cargo measurements to a mechanism-relevant potency readout.

formulation.scoring_methodology: Each component is an uncalibrated ordinal assessment mapped as not_assessed=0, low=1, moderate=2, high=3. total_score is the inspectable component sum for directional comparison only; it is not a probability, validated product score, or approval criterion.

candidates.active_cargo_strategy: Native secretome cargo; source and potency mechanism to be selected

score.methodology: Uncalibrated ordinal component sum; directional comparison only.

candidates.rationale: Matches the operator-selected program concept but remains insufficiently defined for manufacturing or clinical deployment.

candidates.name: Loaded-EV intranasal benchmark
candidates.modality: EV carrier with defined exogenous payload

score.methodology: Uncalibrated ordinal component sum; directional comparison only.

candidates.rationale: A more mechanistically inspectable benchmark scores directionally above the native focus despite not being the chosen product thesis.

candidates.name: Uncharacterized conditioned-medium nasal product

score.methodology: Uncalibrated ordinal component sum; directional comparison only.

candidates.rationale: The broad secretome may be easier to produce but prevents clear attribution of identity, dose, and potency.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Excluded from the current product definition because the local evidence does not support adequate identity, purity, or potency control.

jurisdictions.product_classification: FDA states that exosome products intended to treat disease are generally regulated as drugs and biological products and require premarket review and approval.
applicable_legal_framework: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
Investigational New Drug and biologics licensure pathways
jurisdictions.private_clinic_path: No legitimate routine private-clinic deployment path is identified for an unapproved SGL-001 therapeutic. Human administration would require an applicable authorized clinical investigation or approved product pathway.
jurisdictions.physician_use_path: Physician involvement does not remove federal product approval and investigational requirements described by FDA.
jurisdictions.manufacturing_import_considerations: Manufacturing and distribution for human therapeutic use require product-specific regulatory analysis, applicable authorization, and compliance with manufacturing controls; import does not create a clinic-use exemption.
jurisdictions.cell_tissue_sourcing_rules: Product-specific donor eligibility and human-cell sourcing requirements require specialist review once the source-cell strategy is selected.
jurisdictions.advertising_constraints: Disease-treatment claims for an unapproved exosome product create material enforcement risk; claims must not imply FDA approval or established safety and efficacy.
unresolved_questions: Which IND pathway and FDA review center would apply to the final SGL-001 composition and claims?
What donor eligibility and CMC requirements follow from the selected source and manufacturing process?

Other medical-practice or regenerative-medicine rules require current specialist confirmation
